structured_output.summary: MultiPartParser.parse now closes its temp files on any Exception and re-raises, replacing the old MultiPartException/OSError-only handler. I added a test that feeds a multipart file part and then raises HTTPException(413) from the stream. I couldn't run the tests here. The harness run is the first check.

criteria_notes.note: test_multipart_closes_tempfiles_on_interrupt in tests/test_formparsers.py. It asserts HTTPException(413) propagates and the one temp file created is closed. Before the change the handler only covered MultiPartException/OSError, so the file stayed open and the test fails.
